query: For my 67-year-old male patient, what's the interquartile range of the first recorded SpO2 among males aged 62–72?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS interquartile_range FROM labevents WHERE hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM male_admissions) AND itemid = 2703511;
